summary: Closed the GOOGL long: sold all 7 shares @ $334.33 for a realized +$46.64 (+2.03%), banking 47% of the planned 327.67->342 move and leaving me 100% cash at a $10,046.63 bankroll (+0.47% since inception vs SPY -1.12%). The thesis never broke -- GOOGL made a new high for the move today while SPY -0.8%, QQQ -1.1% and SMH -3.0% -- but reward/risk had decayed from 2.2:1 at entry to 0.58:1, and tonight's FOMC plus MSFT/META prints are a binary my 321 stop cannot survive, since a bad earnings reaction gaps straight through it. My own standing rule is to trade the reaction rather than the event, and I had been exempting this position from it by inertia. I take no new risk into a double binary I have no edge on; I'll read the earnings gap Thursday morning and re-engage on the reaction.

trades.rationale: Took the win at 334.33 (+$46.64): 47% of the target move banked, remaining reward/risk decayed to 0.58:1, and my 321 invalidation is unenforceable through tonight's FOMC and MSFT/META capex prints.
